items.english: "That's right — though day by day we are tired and worried and made to suffer by all sorts of things, two years are already past, you know. In a little while {t:boya} will be walking too."
notes: p28-s1 keeps 二年 as two years though p26-p27 and p25 say three years; preserving the inconsistency rather than correcting to three, passage wins over consistency.

items.english: The man, as if with nothing to do with his hands, looked at the child standing holding the spoon. She at once called gladly, in a loud voice, "{t:boya}," and at the same moment the child let out a loud shout, looking at her mother's face, "{t:umauma}," and banged the spoon down upon the {t:table}.
notes: Grouped p29-p31 as one English paragraph: p29-s2 breaks off mid-speech into p30-p31 action and cannot stand alone.
p29-s1: reading 手持ぶさたのやうに as the man's idleness as he looks, not the child's manner of standing.

items.english: The father hurriedly put rice into the child's mouth.
Before long they laid down their chopsticks.
"Only a little while longer." The man said it strongly, as if in monologue.
notes: Keeps 独言のやうに as spoken aloud, not italicised thought, per style sheet.

items.english: "Yes, we shall work, shall we." She said it, settled and at peace. And with the child held upon her knees, she bared her small nipple and began to give her milk.
notes: Keeps おちついて安らかに as settled and at peace to hold the yasuraka network word invariant.

items.english: "Now, let's clear what is left. And sleep — let's get up early tomorrow, shall we."
notes: No speaker is marked; carrying forward as unattributed speech in the room after her nursing begins, most likely his, but leaving it unassigned as the Japanese does.

items.english: Before long the man stood up. And when he was about to begin clearing the {t:table}, the child was already with cheek against the breast and eyes closed. All about had fallen quiet.

notes: Keeps first and last lines equally bare for the storm frame; no added atmosphere.

data.say: Drafted the supper's close from resolve to whispered storm, keeping dialogue reticent and nursing and clearing exact.
